decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces Civic Canopy branding with Blue Mesa Strategies and replaces the prior brand-elements value with logo and colors; no stale top-level key remains.
Changing the branding and discontinuing the prior font source does not alter the requirement to place supplied photos in the final draft.
The complete-document layout obligation remains valid unchanged despite the branding and typography-source change.
The source decision does not remove or change the obligation to integrate supplied tables into the RFQ draft.
The branding shift and removal of the Civic Canopy font source do not change the required PDF format or print-ready status.
The Canva ownership question is independently introduced in the same message and is not changed by removal of the prior font source.
The requirement to include the organization chart remains unchanged by the branding and typography-source decision.
The typography-source removal has no necessary effect on the 34-page maximum.
Packaging all required RFQ response content into one document remains valid unchanged.
The same-message introduction already records the Blue Mesa-oriented reusable template and prepared-for-client credit line; removing the prior font source requires no additional state change here.
This requirement concerns source files and PDFs for the separate RCP proposal and is unaffected by the RFQ typography change.
This requirement concerns optional maps and infographics for the separate RCP proposal; the RFQ branding and font-source change has no effect on it.
